question: Based on the World Bank global population dataset and the World Bank health nutrition population dataset, how many countries experienced an increase of more than 1% from the previous year to 2018 in both their total population and per capita current health expenditure (PPP)?
sql:
WITH health_2017 AS (
  SELECT country_code, value AS health_2017
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.world_bank_health_population.health_nutrition_population`
  WHERE indicator_code = 'SH.XPD.CHEX.PP.CD' AND year = 2017
),
health_2018 AS (
  SELECT country_code, value AS health_2018
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.world_bank_health_population.health_nutrition_population`
  WHERE indicator_code = 'SH.XPD.CHEX.PP.CD' AND year = 2018
),
pop AS (
  SELECT 
    country_code,
    year_2017,
    year_2018
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.world_bank_global_population.population_by_country`
  WHERE year_2017 IS NOT NULL AND year_2018 IS NOT NULL AND year_2017 > 0 AND year_2018 > 0
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS country_count
FROM pop p
JOIN health_2017 h2017 ON p.country_code = h2017.country_code
JOIN health_2018 h2018 ON p.country_code = h2018.country_code
WHERE SAFE_DIVIDE(p.year_2018 - p.year_2017, p.year_2017) > 0.01
  AND SAFE_DIVIDE(h2018.health_2018 - h2017.health_2017, h2017.health_2017) > 0.01
  AND p.country_code NOT IN (
    'LMC','EAR','WLD','PSS','TSA','SAS','IBT','MIC','LMY','LIC','HIC','IDA','IDB','IDX','HPC','FCS','LDC','LTE','NAC','EUU','ECS','MEA','AFE','ARB','CEB','ECA','EAP','AFW','LCN','CSS','MNA','SSF','TSS'
  )
